critical_code_review_comments: Note: The presence system uses timeout-based calculation (5 minutes). The is_online field stored in DB is not used for calculation - only last_seen timestamp is used. This is by design but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing test users from previous iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Presence system fully functional. Heartbeat interval is 30 seconds (frontend). Timeout is 5 minutes (backend). Current user appears online after heartbeat. Other users appear offline since they haven't sent heartbeats. All presence indicators are grey (offline) as expected.
